description: A three-question reflective chakra check that suggests which energy center to focus on, with its traditional theme, element, Solfeggio frequency, affirmation and associated crystal. For self-reflection; not a diagnosis.

desired_change.description: Which chakra theme matches the change the user wants most

life_area.description: Which chakra theme matches the life area that feels most constrained (root=security, sacral=joy/creativity, solar-plexus=confidence, heart=relationships, throat=expression, third-eye=clarity, crown=purpose)

stress_signal.description: Which chakra area the user associates with how stress shows up for them

name: check_my_chakras
title: Chakra Balance Check
